summary: Iteration 3 regression verified the public Expo preview at 390x844 and backend admissions APIs. Overview, queue search/filter, all applicant stage controls, document interaction, new application creation, persistence, invalid document rejection, payment overage rejection, and ObjectId-safe responses passed.
action_items: Align frontend/.env and source code with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL key, or document the intentional EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL convention.
Normalize filter testIDs to kebab-case (for example filter-documents) to match the accessibility guideline and avoid selector ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx builds API from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the environment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the current preview works only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured.
The first pytest invocation failed because the regression test assumes EXPO_BACKEND_URL is exported in the shell; rerun with the configured frontend value passed explicitly succeeded.
seed_data_creation: UI test created APP-ITER3-UI; prior shared iteration records remain in the database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview https://mvp-to-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Stage controls are wrapped and all four are reachable at 390x844. Use filter-all (not filter-All stages); stage-specific IDs currently preserve capitalization.
rca_of_issue: The prior mobile stage visibility issue is resolved by the wrapped stageRow layout. The only observed regression-test failure was harness configuration: EXPO_BACKEND_URL was absent from the shell, not an API failure.
